category: hosted customer identity and access management (passwordless, social, MFA, SSO, federated apps)

free_tier.stated: Free Forever plan at USD 0: 7,500 monthly active users, 10 monthly active tenants, 3 SSO connections, 1 federated app (OIDC), 5 test users, 10,000 M2M exchanges, 2,000 monthly active consents, 2,000 monthly active tokens, all auth methods, MFA, RBAC, no Descope watermark, community support and a 99% SLA; no overages, and an upgrade is required to exceed the limits
free_tier.notes: An MAU is any user that signs up or signs in over a 1-month period; a tenant is active when two or more users are associated and at least one logs in within a month. Multiple sign-ins by one user carry no extra charge. The paid tiers are Pro from USD 249/month, Growth from USD 799/month and a custom Enterprise plan.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: no per-object size cap is stated on the pages read; the platform applies a 200-task cap per flow and a 100-user cap on a batch create when a cleartext password is used

retention.stated: Audit events are retained for 1 week on Free Forever, 1 month on Pro and Growth, and a custom period on Enterprise

egress.terms: not applicable: a hosted authentication API; no traffic allowance or per-GB egress price is published

interface_detail: A REST API over HTTPS with JSON request and response bodies, documented by a downloadable OpenAPI file. Sign-up and sign-in endpoints take the Project ID as a Bearer token; user-scoped endpoints take Project ID and Refresh JWT; management endpoints take a Management Key or Access Key. A 429 answer with a Retry-After header signals a rate limit.
tooling: Backend SDKs for Node, Python, Go, Java, Ruby, PHP and .NET, a descope CLI, the REST API with an OpenAPI description, the visual Flows builder, and embeddable admin widgets
chaining: An OIDC or SAML identity provider in front of apps on free compute, with visual sign-in flows, passwordless and social login, MFA and RBAC; user management runs through the Management API.

limits.value: 7,500 monthly active users on Free Forever
10 monthly active tenants, 3 SSO connections and 1 federated app on Free Forever
10,000 M2M exchanges, 2,000 monthly active consents and 2,000 monthly active tokens on Free Forever
the REST API allows 100 requests per 60 seconds with a 60-second backoff
user management paths under /v1/mgmt/user/* allow 1000 requests per 60 seconds; create paths allow 100 per 60 seconds
audit events kept 1 week on Free Forever

binding_note: The 7,500-MAU ceiling binds first for a growing app; unlike paid tiers, Free Forever has no overages, so passing the user, tenant or SSO limit needs an upgrade.

identity_cost.detail: The console sign-in page asks for an email address and offers Google, GitHub, Microsoft and SSO as alternatives; the marketing sign-up page invites a Free Forever account. The pricing page states no credit card for Free Forever. Whether a later registration step asks for a phone number or a card is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: Rate-limited calls return HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. Beyond 7,500 MAUs, 10 tenants or 3 SSO connections a warning email and a grace period apply before the app may lose access.
confidence_note: Quota, retention and tier prices come from the first-party pricing page, and rate limits and API access from the first-party documentation. No probe was run and no account was opened; a sign-up would move the identity fields up a rung.
